verification.scope: Execution and contract checks; business ambiguities require operator answers

open_questions: No source column carries pack size, effective dates, barcode, category, brand, stock or promotions; those optional pointers are left unpopulated rather than guessed.
/status is absent from the source; the schema default 'active' applies and no status value is fabricated.

notes: Only one table detected (sheet 'export', header row 0, 12 data rows). No inventory, promotion, category, brand, barcode, effective-date or pack-size columns exist in the source, so those target pointers should be left unpopulated rather than guessed.
SKU is profiled as int (470001-470012) but the source cells are zero-padded 8-character codes; the connector must read the column as text to preserve 00470001-00470012 for /sku.
Currency is EUR on every row, so the schema default 'THB' must not be applied; no FX conversion should occur.
Tax evidence is explicit and self-consistent: Tax included = 'No' and Tax rate = '5%' on all rows, i.e. VAT-exclusive net prices at a 5% rate (fixture value, not a real-world tax statement).

/prices/*/effective_from and /prices/*/effective_to have no source columns; the price collection identity is (price_list, effective_from), so only one price row per SKU with a null effective_from can be produced without inventing dates.
/unit/pack_size has no source column ('BT' only expresses the sell unit), so it should remain null rather than be derived from the unit code.

tables.reason: Sheet 'export' has one row per SKU (12 rows, SKU and Product name each 12 distinct) and every non-identity column is price-related: Currency (EUR, 12/12), Sales unit (BT, 12/12), Price list (standard, 12/12), Net price (12 distinct, 1234.56-1356.77), Tax included (No, 12/12), Tax rate (5%, 12/12). Grain is product-level, but the column set is a single standard price list, so the table acts as the pricing source that also carries product identity.

columns.name: SKU
columns.reason: Header 'SKU'; 12 distinct values, one per row, zero-padded 8-digit codes (00470001-00470012) with a barcode_like hint. Must be read as text so leading zeros survive into the string /sku.

columns.name: Product name
columns.reason: Header 'Product name'; 12 distinct non-empty strings, one per SKU (e.g. 'SIM neutral 1'...'SIM neutral 12'), matching the product_name synonyms (name, item name).

columns.name: Currency
columns.reason: Header 'Currency'; single distinct value 'EUR' on all 12 rows, already a valid ISO-4217 3-letter code matching the /currency pattern ^[A-Z]{3}$; explicit in the source, not inferred from country.

columns.name: Sales unit
columns.reason: Header 'Sales unit'; constant 'BT' (12/12), a known SAP-style unit abbreviation that unit_normalize resolves to BOTTLE, one of the enum_hint values. Explicit source value, no pack-size column present.

columns.name: Price list
columns.reason: Header 'Price list'; constant 'standard' on all 12 rows, matching the synonym 'price list' and reinforcing the contract/schema default price_list='standard'; also used as a collection identity key with effective_from.

columns.name: Net price
columns.reason: Header 'Net price'; price_like numeric column, never null, 12 distinct values 1234.56-1356.77 with 2-decimal precision to preserve; 'net price' is listed among the price.amount synonyms.

columns.name: Tax included
columns.reason: Header 'Tax included'; boolean column, constant 'No' on all 12 rows, so each price is VAT-exclusive and /prices/*/vat_included should be false (required field in the contract); parse_bool maps 'No' to false.

columns.name: Tax rate
columns.reason: Header 'Tax rate'; percent-typed column, constant '5%' on all 12 rows. Treated as an explicit source VAT rate and converted to the fraction 0.05 (percent_to_fraction) rather than assumed from the schema default 0.07; it is a fictional fixture rate.

/status is absent from the source; the schema default 'active' applies and no status value is fabricated.
changes_from_draft: /sku: replaced plain trim with a text read that normalises to the source's own 8-character zero-padded width (00470001-00470012), so leading zeros cannot be lost by numeric inference; added not_null/unique quality rules.
/prices/*/price_list: now read from the explicit 'Price list' column ('standard') instead of a constant.
/prices/*/vat_included: now derived with parse_bool from 'Tax included' = 'No' (default false) instead of an unsupported constant; evidence references the actual column.
/prices/*/vat_rate: added from the explicit 'Tax rate' = '5%' → 0.05 (percent_to_fraction), instead of relying on the schema default 0.07; 'Tax rate' is no longer an unmatched column.
/currency: kept the explicit 'EUR' value mapping, added MYR to the code table; schema default THB not applied and no FX conversion.
/unit/sell_unit: kept unit_normalize on 'Sales unit' ('BT' → BOTTLE by the built-in unit table); /unit/pack_size left null because the file has no pack-size column.
Prices collection: link kept on SKU, dedupe key aligned to the price identity prefix (/price_list) since no effective_from exists to complete the key.
/status and all date fields left unmapped: no source evidence, contract defaults/examples only.
